snippet.title: Illusion Bowling mobile game trailer
snippet.description:
Download for iOS: 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/illusion-bowling/id6744579956

Download for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.SymphonyGames.IllusionBowling 

Illusion Bowling is all about rolling balls through a world of optical illusion. You have to hit a bowling pin with a ball but it is impossible in the normal world. Only by using new pathways that get created by optical illusions it becomes possible. Your tool for creating the optical illusion pathways is merely changing the view perspective. If two distant platforms look from a certain view angle as if they touch each other then the ball can roll over from one platform to the other, like over a virtual bridge. This way you can create virtual bridges, virtual walls or shift the ball sideways by scratching one platform over another.
